title: István Bibó: The Misery of Small Eastern European States
grammar: Complex diagnostic cleft clauses in political analysis (éppen abban áll, hogy...)
goal: I can summarize István Bibó's diagnosis of Central-Eastern European political hysteria, existential fear, and democratic courage.
I can use complex diagnostic cleft constructions ('éppen abban áll, hogy...', 'az ok nem más, mint...') in political discourse.
I can discuss Bibó's conduct during the 1956 Revolution and his famous manifesto 'Nem engedhetünk a szellemi függetlenségből'.
